name: altoroj-final-discovered-account-balance
description: Sign in to the challenged AltoroJ surface using synthetic username {{username}} and synthetic password {{password}}, enter account record {{accountId}} in the nested legacy account console, inspect it, visually read the canvas-rendered Available balance, and return it as output balance.

steps.description: The banking sign-in page is the required first step before accessing the account console.

control.robustnessRationale: Use the uniquely named Sign In link provided in the current page controls.

steps.description: The sign-in form is visible and the username field is empty, so enter the provided synthetic username first.

control.label: Username
control.robustnessRationale: The username textbox is the first empty credential field, identified by its nearby visible label and provided controlled selector.

steps.description: The username is already populated and the password field is the next unmet sign-in condition.

control.label: Password
control.robustnessRationale: The password textbox is empty and is identified by its nearby Password label with the provided controlled fallback.

steps.description: The login credentials are already present, so submit the form to continue.

control.robustnessRationale: The only login submit button is identifiable by its controlled CSS fallback and the credentials are already set.

steps.description: Enter the caller-supplied account record in the nested legacy console.

control.robustnessRationale: The textbox is anchored by the Account record label; the generated identifier suffix is deliberately ignored.
The only button in the nested legacy account console is the inspect action.
